newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commissioner Franz Fischler would visit U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Dan Glickman in Washington on June 16.
Spokesman Jochen Kubosch briefed on the Court of Justice judgments.

Van der Pas briefed on Commission President Jacques Santer's visit to French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Lionel Jospin. He said Santer had been struck by France's desire to bring the stability pact to a conclusion at the Amsterdam European Council. He also said Santer would soon contact Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok to contribute to a compromise to be elaborated by the Dutch Presidency.
In answer to a question van der Pas said there was a need for "stimulation of the convergence" in the field of employment.
Spokesman Peter Guilford said he hoped to be able to announce the conclusion of a mutual recognition agreement (MRA) with the U.S. on Friday.

Spokesman Willy Helin confirmed that the Commission had conducted investigation in Germany and the UK in a series of companies, including Archer Daniels Midland Co, over allegations of price-fixing in the amino acids market.

Asked to react to the UK's request for a two-year delay after its ratification to transpose the EU Treaty's social chapter into national law, spokeswoman Barbara Nolan said the Commission would like to see the transposition happen as soon as possible. Nolan denied that new proposals in this field would be frozen during the two-year period.
Asked why the UK wanted such a delay, Nolan said she did not want to answer.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/503: Conference "The role of the small enterprises and the craft sector in local development", Serpa (Portugal) 13 and 14 June 1997.
- IP/97/513: Commission launches competition to identify the best job-creating project co-financed by the EU.
- IP/97/516: Commission clears acquisition of Hoechst AG's specialty chemicals business by Clariant AG.
- IP/97/517: Commission approves Italian group Stet participation into Mobilkom Austria.
- Action plan for the Single Market (CSE(97)1 final).
